title: Matrix LR down-sweep (MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03)
description: Decreased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 (Muon LR for transformer matrix params), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005856, worse than baseline 1.002279, and nearly identical to round 2's up-sweep result (~1.006 at MATRIX_LR=0.05). Both directions away from 0.04 regress by roughly the same amount, which tightly brackets MATRIX_LR=0.04 as a local optimum. Future rounds should stop perturbing MATRIX_LR and move to a genuinely unexplored axis (e.g. WINDOW_PATTERN, HEAD_DIM, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE, or EMBEDDING_LR).
